entry.title: New: dsh-serendipity
entry.summary: Turns the user into an RPG protagonist: after each finished user turn a random "adventure" may trigger, drawn from 700+ events across 7 themed pools (sci-fi, fantasy, ancient, anime, novels, wuxia, urban), growing six persistent attributes (strength, intelligence, agility, charisma, luck, vitality) with XP, levels and attribute-weighted story branches, configured via a settings-page UI. Exact install spec: github:pocketswpu/dsh-serendipity. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
